==='''Brandon's Wheel of Time Reread on Twitter - 18-21 January 2011'''===

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27437526083960832 Brandon on Twitter - 18 January 2011]
Oh, Rand. You're such a...a...well, teenage boy in some of these chapters. Also, a wool-headed fool.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27438162376658944 Brandon]
Hide in fear, paranoid that the Aes Sedai want you...then the moment you think Egwene might be in danger, out you go, sword in hand!


[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27442188845580288 Brandon]
I often equate writers and stage magicians, using misdirection, foreshadowing, and false leads to keep a plot interesting.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27442514331967488 Brandon]
If you want a great example of this, watch how RJ hides a certain traitor in TGH in plain sight, yet keeps you misdirected.


[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27443828902338560 Brandon]
Much has been made of Moiraine thinking of Mat: "He is not necessary with the Horn gone." (This is long before he's blown it.)

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27444049610809344 Brandon]
I think it's a lot of fuss over nothing. Her plan was to have Mat, eager for adventure, draw Rand into carrying the Horn south.


[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27447096831381505 Brandon]
Foreshadowing some probably missed in TGH Ch7. Prophecy of the Shadow found in the prison: "Which hand shelters? Which hand slays?"

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27452012228513792 Brandon]
(For further reading on that foreshadowing I mentioned, look for a chapter titled "The One He Lost" in TGS.)

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/27453454897127424 Terez]
Ah yeah, I remember reading it now. Seemed to me to be more of a poetic connection than a real one, though.

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/27454404089090049 Terez]
I phrased that badly, but I don't know if I would have put it in the 'foreshadowing' category. Maybe 'retroshadowing'.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27484185748840448 Brandon]
The connection there is poetic. The foreshadowing isn't of that moment, but more the concept.


[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27458970721460225 Brandon]
Yes, there is other foreshadowing in the books that I'm not telling you about because it references AMOL.

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/27462078100930561 Terez]
I will hopefully catch some of those, though I'm bound to catch a few red herrings as well. :)

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27487935804739584 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/27488529919508481 Terez]
haha, and you know I will be scouring the pages of your vicinity looking for it. :D

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/27490013226733570 Terez]

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/27492067420676096 Terez]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27495120517464064 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/Theoryland/status/27607717195554816 Matt Hatch]
Readers, let's go HCFF on an "innocent" comment by @[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson BrandonSandrson] re: an AMoL foreshadowing in TGH, discuss! http://bit.ly/gMZvLI

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27855577682018304 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27466158403747841 Brandon]
Unless I'm missing one, our first Egwene viewpoint in the series is 1/4 the way into TGH. She is our fifth viewpoint character.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27489517506138112 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/LiterateKnits/status/27476136313229312 Erin Kelly]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27490131057311744 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27494630073311232 Brandon]
Fortune prick me, a Domon viewpoint. Don't know if I'll count him as the 6th VP character, though. We don't return to him frequently.

[http://twitter.com/KadereHadnan/status/27847096417648641 Kadere]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27502405532782593 Brandon]
I've been asked who was behind the plot to see Domon dead in TGH. It was Hamlet, obviously.



[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27844879551823872 Brandon on Twitter - 19 January 2011]
One reason the WoT's world works so well is that there's a logic to the magic and the magical (yet non Power-related) abilities...

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27845172955975680 Brandon]
However, RJ didn't try to tie it all up too neatly. For a very big world, with lots of history, this helps keep it from being stale.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27845172955975680 Zeldaar on Twitter - 20 January 2011]
Speaking of magical non-Power related abilities - whatever happened to sniffers?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28185734028468224 Brandon]
Still around. Hurin was in TGS.


[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27854847906684928 Brandon]
I'll count Fain as our 6th viewpoint character (or, maybe he's 5th and Egwene is 6th.) I love the scene where they find the dead Fade.

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/27929204620271616 Terez]
Your Inquisitors in Mistborn always made me think of that Fade. Sorry if I've said that before; I can't remember, lol.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28191934858141696 Brandon]
Yes I think there's got to be some kind of unconscious thing going on there on my part. (Re: Fades and Inquisitors.)


[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27879930628931584 Brandon]
Some very telling moments in the conversation between Ishamael and Rand in the Portal world of TGH.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28552687830175744 Brandon on Twitter - 21 January 2011]
Lots of responses Re: Rand and Lady Selene. Let me say this. Yes, Rand is being a wool-headed fool. But I remember being that young.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28553088663031808 Brandon]
I remember when I realized the prettiest girl I knew was also a huge jerk. It was a stunning revelation. Yet it took 2 years to make.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28555247458721793 Brandon]
Rand is not the first teenage boy to have trouble seeing the obvious in a situation like this. In fact, it would be odd otherwise.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28566004787318785 Brandon]
Egwene to Elayne on their first meeting in the White Tower, right before meeting Min: "Rand seems to meet a lot of girls." Yup.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28574757356052480 Brandon]
First Min viewpoint is at the halfway mark to TGH. I'm always amazed by how many viewpoints we get before Mat gets one.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28575306969260032 Brandon]
I have to look back a long time, back almost 20 years, to remember that originally, I saw Mat as a side character--and this is why.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/28579803296694272 Brandon]
I've always felt that Thom should be more surprised, excited, or...something to see Rand again here in TGH when they meet.

''(Note...this conversation was recorded because Brandon comments on it eventually. But most of it is just two fans talking about Cadsuane.)''

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27686390288351232 Luckers on Twitter - 19 January 2011]
Re-reading tGS--I know I'm a silly Cadsuane lover, but I really don't like the tGS Cadsuane and Tam scene.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27686529027547136 Luckers]
Not because Tam gives Cadsuane the verbal slap down, but because Cadsuane's stupidity in this scene cheapens Tam's victory.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27687163864809472 Luckers]
What should have been Tam's greatest moment is merely cathartic for those who hate Cadsuane.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27687429557198848 Luckers]
I know that she was off balance with worry about Rand--but even so, Tam defeating Cadsuane in her prime is a brilliant moment lost.

[http://twitter.com/AstridaFN/status/27688015220449280 Astrida Fitri N]
You mean you wished she had clever retorts?

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27691319107256320 Luckers]
No, actually. I think in the face of Tam's accusations Cadsuane would have openly agreed and accepted his reprimands.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27691399591763969 Luckers]
Cadsuane has never been afraid of facing the truth.

[http://twitter.com/AstridaFN/status/27691994109190144 Astrida]
In short, her response to Tam's verbal attack was OOC? Hmm, I would have to reread the scene myself.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27695045196910592 Luckers]
It was out of character, yes. Cadsuane's been mostly out of character since the beginning of tGS.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27695305730293760 Luckers]
In my opinion, of course. :D Still, i feel tGS and ToM between them were to be the books were Rand came to equal Cadsuane.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27695530276552704 Luckers]
Instead Cadsuane was made less, and it makes Rand's achievements and shut downs of Cadsuane seem small and petty.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27695673654648833 Luckers]
He did not even have a mission like Cadsuane did. As I said--carthartic to those who hate Cadsuane, but not good scenes.

[http://twitter.com/AstridaFN/status/27695740541206528 Astrida]
Re: Cadsuane's oddity in [http://twitter.com/search?q=%23TGS #TGS]. Maybe you could point this out to @[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson BrandonSandrson], and see what explanation he could offer you.

[http://twitter.com/AstridaFN/status/27697004209508352 Astrida]
Maybe Cadsuane's strength of character was sacrificed for plot's sake, or for that scene's sake. Just maybe.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27697536126943233 Luckers]
I actually did ask @[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson BrandonSandrson] about Cadsuane. And Harriet. Got a fairly similar response from both.

[http://twitter.com/#%21/WoTLuckers/status/27698054819749888 Luckers]
My question was ": I think one of Jim’s strongest talents was the writing of strong women, and arguably the strongest is Cadsuane...

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27698359590461440 Luckers]
...She is the character that fans seem to either love or hate. I’m curious as to your thoughts about her, and her role in the story."

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27698593091559425 Luckers]
Harriet's answer was "Cadsuane has an important role, for sure."

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27699027709526016 Luckers]
@[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson BrandonSandrson]'s was "The fact that people are so passionate about her means that Robert Jordan wrote her the right way."

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27699216465793024 Luckers]
If Cadsuane's strength of character was sacrificed for plot its bad writting, and I don't think Brandon would do that.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27702662988300288 Luckers]
I think this might be a downside of @[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson BrandonSandrson] having been a fan beforehand. The exultation of likeable characters over...

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27702971475173376 Luckers]
.....unlikeable characters. Egwene in the Tower is endemic of this. (though, I loved that anyway @[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson BrandonSandrson]. I'm a hypocrite).

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27703451777507329 Luckers]
I seem to have been on a negative line of thought tonight. Be aware I love your work on WoT and my quibbles are just that.

[http://twitter.com/AstridaFN/status/27707971408494592 Astrida]
I like her, though Verin intrigues me more. God forbid that I should call that scene "bad writing", but I feel that for Tam to dominate the scene, Cadsuane was made to respond that way.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27712921878396928 Luckers]
I disagree. Something along the lines of this would have worked. ... (follow link to see a bit of fanficciness from Luckers) http://tl.gd/88d5tl

[http://twitter.com/AstridaFN/status/27710373201186816 Astrida]
If @BrandonSandrson wasn't a fan, though, he wouldn't handle the books with deepest care like he does. Professionally, still, but not affectionately. :)

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27713817144197121 Luckers]
I agree absolutely that @[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson BrandonSandrson]'s fanhood serves him well--I would not have seen the series written by...

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27713943384367105 Luckers]
...someone who wasn't a fan, and the depth of his devotion to this series is VERY clear.

[http://twitter.com/#%21/WoTLuckers/status/27714139325468672 Luckers]
This is but one point where is was disadvantageous (in my opinion) against a sea of advantages.

[http://twitter.com/AstridaFN/status/27715694548221952 Astrida]
Agreed. And a non fan would treat the greatest fantasy story of the decade as a mere job (whatever the results of @tordotcom's sff poll, I don't care. I'm muley that way).

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27716074946433025 Luckers]
I'm curious what you think about my portrayal of that scene?

[http://twitter.com/AstridaFN/status/27721937522266112 Astrida]
Ok, having compared the original with yours, I must say...yes, the original scene portrayed Cadsuane as being much colder than she necessarily is. Then again in defense of Brandon (why would he need it of me? I'm too full of myself), I think Cadsuane in that scene was someone who felt that she wasn't being respected and valued despite all her efforts for Rand. But yes, the verdict is: that's ooc.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27864621989765120 Brandon]
Ha. I'm afraid that I didn't have a chance to follow all of that. I'm not going to object to Luckers having...

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27864833839857664 Brandon]
...strong opinions here, though. I don't see him saying anything that I can disagree with, except that we see things...

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27864992120311808 Brandon]
...differently. Poor Cads was at her wits end in some of those scenes. She was pretty sure she'd doomed the world.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27865255568740353 Brandon]
Note that the fan/non fan as writer argument is a good one, and one I've mentioned myself. This is what you get.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/27865526147489793 Brandon]
I try hard to not let those things influence me unduly--but if they do, I (by definition) won't be able to notice.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27914587164643328 Luckers]
Lol. I would have been surprised if you had got through all that. We went a bit crazy.

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/27922336162258944 Terez]
Curse you Luckers, now I have to document all that because Brandon commented on it! lol...

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27923673486725121 Luckers]
Hahaha. I'm so gonna look like a douche by the time you're done Terez. *sigh*.

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27916121625595906 Luckers]
My problem with the 'doomed the world' concept is that I reckon Cadsuane would still be there with a stern...

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27916280551968768 Luckers]
... frown as the world burns. Indeed we see her willfully risk the world at the cleansing. There is...

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27916468922359808 Luckers]

[http://twitter.com/WoTLuckers/status/27916656546152448 Luckers]
